findings: [F1: Pipeline Trace stage::load -> plan::build -> cost::fill -> digest] In crates/mori-core/src/stage/mod.rs:73-90, stage::load(src) executes: (1) parser::parse_v2(src) -> Program; (2) profile::require_core2(&program) (crates/mori-core/src/stage/profile.rs:26-31), requiring program.language == "moriarty/2" and program.semantics == "moriarty-core/2"; (3) validate::validate_v2(&program); (4) plan::build(&program) (crates/mori-core/src/stage/plan.rs:59-125), constructing StagePlan with format: "moriarty-stage-plan/1", empty program_hash: "", and ActionPlan entries in action declaration order with populated sites (AwaitSite) and captures (CaptureSlot) but empty segment_cost: [], committed_before: [], and plan_total: UInt(0); (5) validate::plan_invariants(&program, &plan); (6) cost::fill(&program, &mut plan) (crates/mori-core/src/stage/cost.rs:120-151), which populates segment_cost, committed_before, and plan_total for every ActionPlan; (7) validate::cost_invariants(&program, &plan); (8) digest::program_hash(&program) -> [u8; 32] (crates/mori-core/src/stage/digest.rs:20-22); (9) plan.program_hash = digest::hex(&program_hash), mutating plan.program_hash to the 64-character lowercase ASCII hex string before plan hashing; (10) digest::plan_hash(&plan) -> [u8; 32] (crates/mori-core/src/stage/digest.rs:25-38), which verifies that plan.program_hash is 64 lowercase hex characters ([0-9a-f]{64}) and then hashes the fully populated StagePlan.

[F2: Exact Canonical Byte Serialization, Sorting, UTF-8, and Numeric Rules] Both digest::program_hash and digest::plan_hash call stage::digest::digest(value) (crates/mori-core/src/stage/digest.rs:7-9), which computes Sha256::digest(crate::intent::canonical(value)?). In crates/mori-core/src/intent.rs:72-88, intent::canonical(value) converts value via serde_json::to_value, recursively transforms every serde_json::Value::Object by collecting its entries into a std::collections::BTreeMap<String, serde_json::Value> (ordering keys by strict UTF-8 byte / Unicode code-point lexicographical order) while preserving exact element order in every serde_json::Value::Array (recursively sorting nested objects inside array elements), and serializes the resulting Value with compact serde_json::to_vec. The hashed preimage is the exact raw UTF-8 JSON byte sequence with zero whitespace around ':' or ',', no trailing newline, and NO external domain-separation prefix or length framing (unlike intent::signing_message in crates/mori-core/src/intent.rs:194-203, which prepends b"moriarty-owner-intent/2\0" and a 4-byte big-endian length). Strings use standard serde_json UTF-8 serialization (escaping '"', '\\', '\b', '\f', '\n', '\r', '\t', and control bytes 0x00..0x1F as lowercase \u00xx; unescaped UTF-8 otherwise). Numeric rules are split by Rust type: UInt(u128) (crates/mori-core/src/ir.rs:13-18) serializes as a JSON string of canonical base-10 ASCII digits without leading zeros (except "0"); u16 (ExprId, AwaitSite.site, AwaitSite.ordinal, CaptureSlot.ordinal, ActionPlan.statement_count) and u8 (AssetId.scale) serialize as raw JSON integer tokens; bool serializes as raw JSON true or false. Digest rendering (crates/mori-core/src/stage/digest.rs:11-18, crates/mori-core/src/intent.rs:89-91) formats the 32-byte SHA-256 output as a 64-character lowercase ASCII hexadecimal string ([0-9a-f]{64}) with no "0x" prefix, and digest::matches requires exact string equality.

[F3: Context 1 — Exact Program Preimage Schema and Key Ordering (program_hash)] In crates/mori-core/src/ir.rs:33-187, Program serializes to a root JSON object with 7 lexicographically sorted keys: ["actions","assets","expressions","language","name","semantics","states"]. All admitted actions and the entire global expression arena are included in full. Exact nested object schemas and sorted keys: (a) StateDecl: ["initial","name","ty"], where ty is "UInt"|"Bool" and initial is Value; (b) Value (#[serde(tag = "type", content = "value")]): ["type","value"], yielding {"type":"UInt","value":"<decimal>"} or {"type":"Bool","value":true|false}; (c) AssetDecl: ["identity","name"]; (d) AssetId: ["issuer","network","reference","scale"] (scale is JSON integer u8); (e) Expr (#[serde(tag = "kind")]): LiabilityPresent -> ["kind","name"], LiabilityAmount -> ["kind","name"], Literal -> ["kind","value"], Name -> ["kind","name"], Binary -> ["kind","lhs","op","rhs"] (lhs/rhs are JSON integer u16; op is "Add"|"Sub"|"Mul"|"Eq"|"Ne"|"Lt"|"Le"|"Gt"|"Ge"|"And"|"Or"), Not -> ["kind","value"] (value is JSON integer u16); (f) Action: ["inputs","name","statements"]; (g) InputDecl: ["name","ty"]; (h) Statement (#[serde(tag = "kind")], all ExprId fields serialized as JSON integer u16): Await -> ["binders","guard","kind","label"] (binders is array of InputDecl), Let -> ["kind","name","value"], Requires -> ["kind","predicate"], Ensures -> ["kind","predicate"], Next -> ["kind","state","value"], Emit -> ["kind","name","value"], Transfer -> ["amount","asset","from","kind","to"], Fee -> ["amount","asset","from","kind","to"], Liability -> ["amount","asset","creditor","debtor","kind","name"], Discharge -> ["amount","kind","name"].

[F4: Context 2 — Exact StagePlan Preimage Schema and Key Ordering (plan_hash)] In crates/mori-core/src/stage/plan.rs:6-56 and crates/mori-core/src/stage/digest.rs:25-38, StagePlan is hashed only after cost::fill populates all cost fields and stage::load sets plan.program_hash to the 64-char lowercase hex of program_hash(program). StagePlan serializes to a root JSON object with 3 sorted keys: ["actions","format","program_hash"], where format is "moriarty-stage-plan/1" and program_hash is the 64-char lowercase hex string. Exact nested object schemas and sorted keys: (a) ActionPlan: ["action","committed_before","plan_total","segment_cost","sites","statement_count"], where committed_before and segment_cost are arrays of UInt decimal strings (each of length sites.len() + 1), plan_total is a UInt decimal string, sites is an array of AwaitSite, and statement_count is a JSON integer u16; (b) AwaitSite: ["binders","captures","label","ordinal","site"], where ordinal and site are JSON integer u16; (c) StageBinder: ["name","ty"]; (d) CaptureSlot: ["name","ordinal","origin","ty"], where ordinal is JSON integer u16, origin is "Input"|"Let"|"Event", and ty is "UInt"|"Bool".

[F5: Normative Clause Text for Public Observational Contract (M03)] Normative Clause M03 (Core2 Local Identity Digest Contract): (1) Canonical JSON Byte Function: For any serializable Core2 identity structure V in {Program, StagePlan}, canonical_bytes(V) SHALL be the UTF-8 byte sequence of the compact RFC 8259 JSON representation of V in which every JSON object's members are ordered by strict UTF-8 byte lexicographical order of their keys, every JSON array preserves its structural element order, no whitespace or trailing newline is emitted, no external domain prefix or length header is prepended, UInt(u128) values are encoded as canonical base-10 ASCII decimal strings, u16 and u8 values are encoded as base-10 JSON integers, and bool values are encoded as JSON booleans. (2) Program Identity (program_hash): For an admitted Core2 Program P (with language="moriarty/2" and semantics="moriarty-core/2"), program_hash_bytes(P) = SHA256(canonical_bytes(P)) and program_hash_hex(P) = lower_hex_64(program_hash_bytes(P)), binding all declarations in P.states, P.assets, P.expressions, and P.actions. (3) StagePlan Identity (plan_hash): For the cost-filled StagePlan S derived from P with S.format="moriarty-stage-plan/1", S.program_hash=program_hash_hex(P), and every ActionPlan populated with statement_count, sites, segment_cost, committed_before, and plan_total, plan_hash_bytes(S) = SHA256(canonical_bytes(S)) and plan_hash_hex(S) = lower_hex_64(plan_hash_bytes(S)). (4) Diagnostic Scope: Matching program_hash_hex and plan_hash_hex in a local Continuation checks only static program and stage-plan structural/cost identity; it confers zero cryptographic authentication, zero state/capture/event/work integrity, zero replay/consumption protection, and zero proof or ledger authority.

[F6: Security Boundary — What Is and Is Not Bound & Preserved Security-Relevant Ambiguities] (1) Bound: program_hash binds the entire in-memory Program AST/IR (all actions, states, assets, and the complete expressions arena). plan_hash binds format, program_hash (transitively binding Program), and every action's static AwaitSite/CaptureSlot layout and static segment_cost/committed_before/plan_total vectors. (2) Unbound in Continuation/Execution: In Continuation (crates/mori-core/src/stage/mod.rs:111-120), action, site, captures, logical.profile, logical.cap, logical.committed, and boundary (Snapshot: state, balances, liabilities) are unsigned caller-supplied fields outside both digests. StageEvent values, Scenario inputs, and StageSegment traces are likewise outside both digests. Matching hashes on resume does NOT authenticate captures, boundary balances/liabilities/state, event inputs, prior execution history, or logical.cap (which a caller can alter, remove, or raise undetected; resume_preflight in crates/mori-core/src/stage/cost.rs:195-228 checks only static consistency logical.committed == plan.committed_before[site] and effective cap coverage). Continuations remain replayable and untracked ("qualification": "local-reference-stage", "authentication": "none", "consumption": "untracked"). (3) Preserved Ambiguities: (a) intent::canonical is shared without domain prefixes across /1 OwnerIntent program_hash, /3 backend program_hash, and /2 stage::digest::{program_hash, plan_hash}; profile separation relies purely on internal JSON fields ("language":"moriarty/2", "semantics":"moriarty-core/2", "format":"moriarty-stage-plan/1") and profile::require_core1 / decode_via_v1! isolation (crates/mori-core/src/stage/profile.rs:10-31, crates/mori-core/src/ir.rs:456-465); (b) program_hash and plan_hash are sensitive to exact parser expression-arena node ordering and sharing (program.expressions); (c) digest::program_hash and digest::plan_hash do not themselves re-run stage::load validation if called directly in-crate, so public normative identity applies specifically to stage::load-admitted structures.

[F7: Separation of Unadopted Parallel Premises (M01, M02, M04-M07)] Adopting M03 fixes the exact digest function from (Program, StagePlan) to (program_hash, plan_hash). To hand-derive the concrete escrow test preimages and hashes from .mori source without reading parser/plan-builder output, the custodian still requires the separate adoption of: M01 (exact Core2 parser expression-arena allocation, deduplication/sharing, StateDecl.initial treatment, and Statement ExprId numbering), M02 (adoption of the source-observed plan::build addressing rules in crates/mori-core/src/stage/plan.rs:68-109, where AwaitSite.site is 1-based sites.len()+1, AwaitSite.ordinal is 0-based action statement index, and CaptureSlot.ordinal is 0-based input index for Origin::Input, 0-based Let statement index for Origin::Let, and 0-based defining Await statement index for Origin::Event), and M07 (adoption of the static logical cost schedule in crates/mori-core/src/stage/cost.rs:23-151). Full report envelopes and stdout byte goldens additionally require M04 (step value/presence/delta conventions), M05 (outcome_report root/nested key projection), and M06 (pretty-printing byte rules). No test outputs or guessed preimages are derived here.

Both program_hash and plan_hash apply SHA-256 directly to the raw UTF-8 bytes of intent::canonical(value) (serde_json::to_value -> recursive BTreeMap key sort on all JSON objects preserving array order -> compact serde_json::to_vec with no whitespace, no trailing newline, and no external domain prefix) and render digests as 64 lowercase ASCII hex characters. Program preimage binds the complete admitted Program (including all actions and the global expressions arena); StagePlan preimage binds format ("moriarty-stage-plan/1"), the already-filled 64-hex program_hash, and all actions with their AwaitSite/CaptureSlot layouts and cost::fill-populated segment_cost, committed_before, and plan_total arrays. Matching program_hash and plan_hash is a local diagnostic consistency check only and does NOT authenticate continuation state/balances/liabilities, captures, event inputs, execution history, or logical.cap, nor does it provide replay protection, proof validity, or ledger authority.
